title: Grateful Dead Live at Merramec Community College on 1970-05-14
source: Master Soundboard Reel > Cassette > DAT> CDR

ai_review.summary: High‑energy vintage show with standout performances of Lovelight, Speedway Boogie and a ripping China>Rider jam; recording is clean enough for enjoyment.
ai_review.review: Fans rave about the hard‑charging playing right to the final note of "Lovelight" and hail this as their favorite version of "Speedway Boogie" complete with the 'Nobody's Fault' jam. The set also delivers a ripping Schoolgirl, New Speedway and an inspired China>Rider sequence, making it a solid vintage performance despite one reviewer’s disappointment that "Cold Jordan" was absent.

ai_rating.rationale: Three enthusiastic reviews (average 4.7 stars) praise the musical performance; no recording‑quality complaints, so a strong overall rating is justified.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific comments on sound quality; absence of criticism suggests the recording is at least listenable.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set is described as hard‑driving and full of vibrant jams, with strong transitions especially in the China>Rider sequence.
